svg.title: Solution overview

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One production classification shown; OFFICIAL, PROTECTED and SECRET are identical. Each pool is split across the primary and secondary sites.
